notes.title: First game patch
notes.content:
Today we are proud to release first game patch containing last-minute fixes, some localizations and Game Controller support! While we can't guarantee compatibility with every and all possible models, game is expected to work with devices with at least DPad buttons, any types of control sticks, and A/B or Start/Back buttons for selection. Also you can control all the interface with game controller.

List of changes:
* fixed English language typos
* fixed music looping + new music track
* added Portuguese localization for level tasks (many thanks to our player that translated the game and decided to stay anonymous!)
* added full Ukrainian localization
* added support for game controllers (Logitech, Genius, XInput, PS4, etc.)
* fixed Black Hole achievement
* fixed liquids falling thru the obstacles 
* other changes and improvements
